fields.incident_description: On 02/04/2026, at about 11:35, I was driving my 2008 Honda CRV on 5619 River Road, Naperville, IL. The road was dry. The main damage is to the front door panel, rocker panel. I took the car to Precision Auto Body and they estimated the repair at $7,050.00.
